# habitatPredictR

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of habitatPredictR is to automate the process of converting outputs from state-and-transition simulation models into habitat predictions. 

## Installation

You can install the development version of habitatPredictR from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("alberta-conservation/habitatPredictR")
```

## Example

A basic example is being created

```{r example}
library(habitatPredictR)
## basic example code
```
